author: Allie Kelly
title: She works in healthcare and pays $787 a month for insurance. She still can't afford her daughter's care.
description: Cassenda Nelson, 47, is overwhelmed by insurance costs and medical debt due to her daughter's health condition. She's worried about paying bills.
content:
Cassenda Nelson is a mother of four in southwest Georgia.Photo Courtesy of Cassenda Nelson
  • Cassenda Nelson, 47, struggles to afford care for her daughter's complex health conditions.
